candidates.name: D3-Gym
candidates.recommended_use: immediate small post-gate heldout loop while full environments are admitted

candidates.name: ScienceAgentBench
candidates.task_evaluator_form: self-contained Python program output, execution results, cost metrics, contamination mitigations

historical_kaggle_position.downloadable_kaggle_fallback: allowed only if docs/research/journal admission remains blocked and the loop still proves a reusable field-level technique
historical_kaggle_position.kaggle_cli_public_dataset_access: works per existing Kaggle CLI decision receipt
historical_kaggle_position.mle_bench_downloads: blocked by prior 403 receipts; MLE is not the active path

selection.why: D3-Gym is already locally frozen with external task rows, evaluator scripts, and a source URL, so it can support the next bounded A/B/C heldout loop without another credential/data blocker. ScienceAgentBench, RE-Bench, and PaperBench are stronger field-level validation tracks but require admission receipts first.

sha_convention: bytes on disk as-is (binary read, no line-ending normalization)
